intro: A Filled Crystal Phial contains sacred waters drawn from the moonwell just north of Aldrassil in Shadowglen. Gathered at the instruction of Tenaron Stormgrip, this water serves as a novice's introduction to the sacred and volatile power coursing through Teldrassil.

p: To prepare young night elves before they venture into the wider world, Tenaron Stormgrip sends them to gather water from the moonwell nestled in Shadowglen. The phial holds more than simple spring water; moonwells are infused with residual energies traced back to the ancient Well of Eternity. While the Sentinels honor these sites as blessed shrines of Elune and druids channel their restorative qualities into tending nature, the arcane sorcery of old remains strictly forbidden. Drawing this water is the first step in understanding the sacrifices of Mount Hyjal and the delicate balance required to nurture Teldrassil.
